name: @lmntlz/sim
//: NO root export, deliberately. `import from '@lmntlz/sim'` must fail to resolve, so nobody reaches the resolver through a barrel file. The seam is a resolution error, not a convention.
//exports: Each subpath resolves types from the BUILD and runtime from source — see the long note in @lmntlz/content's package.json for why. The seam is unaffected: a missing subpath is still a resolution error, and `types` never adds a root export. NOTE: no `//`-prefixed comment keys INSIDE the exports map — a key that does not start with `.` makes Node read the whole map as a conditions object, and every subpath in the workspace stops resolving at once.
//exports.resolver/persistence: The seed's only route to storage, kept OUT of ./resolver so it cannot be reached by autocomplete. One subpath, two functions; `seedValue` stays unreachable. A grep for this specifier finds every caller.
